$comment: components.objects carries the consumers and endpoints the api_product seeds reference by @ref (copied from integriq_seed_data.json, which nothing imports), so those references resolve on a fresh install. ADR-037 register fragment (api-product-gateway). Declares the api_product and api_product_subscription schemas backing the API Products gateway layer (a named, versioned bundle of existing Endpoints a Consumer can subscribe to at a rate-limit tier), and deep-merges the fields needed to support them onto three pre-existing schemas: call_log (product/endpoint/responseTime — general-but-scoped inbound observability, endpoint-runtime REQ-EP-009) and approval_request (subscriptionId — the subscription-approval creation seam, api-product-gateway REQ-APG-004 / design.md Decision 4). See openspec/changes/archive/2026-07-15-api-product-gateway/design.md#database-changes and specs/api-product-gateway/spec.md.

api_product.title: API Product
api_product.summary: A named, versioned bundle of existing Endpoints a Consumer can discover and subscribe to at a rate-limit tier
api_product.description: Groups existing Endpoint uuids into a discoverable, subscribable unit with named tiers, an optional approval gate per tier, and version-deprecation signalling (RFC 8594 Sunset/Deprecation headers). One row per (productSlug, version) pair: see design.md Decision 1. See openspec/specs/api-product-gateway/spec.md#requirement-api-product-groups-endpoints-into-a-named-versioned-bundle-req-apg-001.

name.description: Human-readable product name shown in the API Products UI
name.title: Name

description.description: Longer-form description of what this product offers
description.title: Description

productSlug.description: Stable slug grouping every version-row of the same logical product (design.md Decision 1): e.g. 'woo-publications'
productSlug.title: Product Slug

version.description: Semver version of this product row
version.title: Version

visibility.description: Discoverability of the product in the API Products listing
visibility.title: Visibility

status.description: 'draft' is not yet published: a product integriq generates (such as an app's data feeds) starts there, and an administrator makes it active once its API design check has no open error (REQ-ADRC-003). When 'deprecated' (with sunsetDate set), every response served through this product's endpoints carries Deprecation/Sunset headers (RFC 8594). When 'retired', the product's endpoints answer 410 Gone to subscribers. Deprecating, moving the sunset date or retiring writes one product_change_notice per active subscription (access-developer-portal-and-subscriptions D5)
status.title: Status

sunsetDate.description: Required when status is 'deprecated': rendered as the RFC 8594 Sunset header (HTTP-date format) on every response served through this product's endpoints
sunsetDate.title: Sunset Date

endpoints.description: Uuids of existing Endpoints grouped by this product version. Creating/updating an api_product MUST NOT create, modify, or delete the Endpoints it references.
endpoints.title: Endpoints

tiers.description: Map of tierName -> {rateLimit:{requestsPerWindow,windowSeconds}, quota:{limit,period}, requiresApproval:boolean}. Same rateLimit/quota shape as the consumer schema. A tier with requiresApproval:true gates subscription via ApprovalService::suspendForSubscription().
tiers.title: Tiers

rateLimit.description: Optional inbound short-window burst limiter for this tier. Absent = unlimited.
rateLimit.title: Rate Limit

requestsPerWindow.description: Maximum number of requests allowed within one window
requestsPerWindow.title: Requests per window

windowSeconds.description: Length of the rate-limit window in seconds
windowSeconds.title: Window (seconds)

quota.description: Optional inbound long-horizon fair-use cap for this tier. Absent = unlimited.
quota.title: Quota

limit.description: Maximum number of requests allowed within one period
limit.title: Quota limit

period.description: Calendar period the quota resets on
period.title: Quota period

requiresApproval.description: When true, subscribing at this tier creates a pending_approval subscription gated by ApprovalService::suspendForSubscription() instead of activating immediately
requiresApproval.title: Requires Approval

approverGroup.description: NC group id notified when a subscription to this tier suspends pending approval (required when requiresApproval is true)
approverGroup.title: Approver Group

defaultTier.description: The tier name new subscriptions default to when none is explicitly named
defaultTier.title: Default Tier

api_product_subscription.title: API Product Subscription
api_product_subscription.summary: A Consumer's subscription to an API Product at a named tier
api_product_subscription.description: Gates a Consumer's access to a product's endpoints at a named rate-limit tier, optionally behind a human-in-the-loop approval gate reusing ApprovalService's generic approval_request state machine. See openspec/specs/api-product-gateway/spec.md#requirement-consumer-subscribes-to-an-api-product-at-a-tier-req-apg-003.

product.description: FK to the subscribed api_product (UUID; many-to-one; onDelete=CASCADE: when the product is destroyed, its subscriptions cascade-delete with it)
product.title: Product

consumer.description: FK to the subscribing Consumer (UUID; many-to-one; onDelete=CASCADE: when the Consumer is destroyed, its subscriptions cascade-delete with it)
consumer.title: Consumer

tier.description: The subscribed tier's name, referencing a key of the product's tiers map
tier.title: Tier

status.description: State machine: pending_approval -> active|rejected, or active -> revoked. A subscription that is not active does not receive its tier's rate-limit/quota policy.
status.title: Status

approvalRequestId.description: FK to the approval_request created by ApprovalService::suspendForSubscription() when the tier requires approval (UUID; many-to-one; onDelete=SET_NULL); null for a tier that activates immediately
approvalRequestId.title: Approval Request

requesterUserId.description: NC user id who created the subscription, or null for an unauthenticated/API-key caller
requesterUserId.title: Requester User ID

activatedAt.description: Timestamp the subscription became active (immediately on creation for a no-approval tier, or on approval for a gated tier)
activatedAt.title: Activated At

revokedAt.description: Timestamp the subscription was revoked, when applicable
revokedAt.title: Revoked At

expiresAt.description: Optional end of the subscription. After it, calls through the subscription are refused with 403 naming the date, and SubscriptionExpiryJob marks it expired; its owner is reminded fourteen days before (access-developer-portal-and-subscriptions D6). Absent: the subscription does not end on its own
expiresAt.title: Expires At

expiryReminderSentAt.description: When SubscriptionExpiryJob wrote the fourteen-days-ahead subscription-expiring notice, so the reminder goes out once
expiryReminderSentAt.title: Expiry Reminder Sent At

product_change_notice.title: Product Change Notice
product_change_notice.summary: A notice to one subscriber that an API product they use changed, or that their subscription is about to end
product_change_notice.description: One row per active subscription, written when an administrator deprecates a product, sets or moves its sunset date, publishes a new version or retires it, and fourteen days before a subscription ends. The row is the record of who was told what and when; its created trigger sends the Nextcloud notification and the mail. See openspec/changes/access-developer-portal-and-subscriptions/design.md D5 and D6.

product.description: FK to the api_product the notice is about
product.title: Product

productName.description: The product's name when the notice was written, so the notification can name it
productName.title: Product Name

subscription.description: FK to the subscription whose owner was told
subscription.title: Subscription

recipientUserId.description: Nextcloud user id of the subscription's owner: the consumer's userId, else the user who requested the subscription
recipientUserId.title: Recipient

message.description: The text the subscriber reads, naming the product and, where there is one, the date
message.title: Message

effectiveDate.description: The sunset date or the subscription's end date the notice is about, when it has one
effectiveDate.title: Effective Date

sentAt.description: When the notice was written and its notification sent
sentAt.title: Sent At

subject.nl: Wijziging in een API die je gebruikt: {{productName}}
subject.en: A change to an API you use: {{productName}}

x-openregister-seed.message: Besluiten API is deprecated and is retired on 2027-01-01.

product.description: FK to the api_product an inbound request was dispatched through (UUID, many-to-one, onDelete=SET_NULL: when the product is destroyed its call_log rows remain for audit but lose their product pointer). Only set on inbound rows for product-attached endpoints (endpoint-runtime).
product.title: API Product

endpoint.description: FK to the dispatched Endpoint (UUID, many-to-one, onDelete=SET_NULL: when the endpoint is destroyed its call_log rows remain for audit but lose their endpoint pointer). Only set on inbound rows for product-attached endpoints (endpoint-runtime).
endpoint.title: Endpoint

responseTime.description: Wall-clock duration in milliseconds from dispatch start to response ready. Top-level (unlike the outbound path's nested response.responseTime) so it is directly aggregatable for the gateway analytics percentile queries (api-product-gateway, prometheus-metrics).
responseTime.title: Response Time (ms)

consumer.description: FK to the consumer an inbound product request authenticated as (UUID, many-to-one, onDelete=SET_NULL: when the consumer is destroyed its call_log rows remain for audit but lose their consumer pointer). Absent when no consumer was resolved, such as on a public endpoint. Splits the gateway analytics per consumer (gateway-usage-per-consumer-and-endpoint).
consumer.title: Consumer

subscriptionId.description: FK to the gated api_product_subscription (subscription-approval case; set instead of endpointId/ruleId/synchronizationId). See api-product-gateway and ApprovalService::suspendForSubscription().
subscriptionId.title: Subscription
